notes.title: Play the Demo on Itch July 1!
notes.notes:
The Astral Horizon demo will be available publicly for the first time on July 1, 2023! You can find the Itch page [url=https://infohazard.itch.io/astral-horizon]here[/url].

Additionally, if you're interested in helping playtest the demo, you can join the Infohazard Games Discord server [url=https://discord.com/invite/V2jTnpS8zZ]here[/url]. A playtest build will be available 6/24!
